# PPE & Respiratory Protection Training

> PPE & Respiratory Protection Training: 5 self-paced online courses from $29.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [OSHA Eye and Face Protection for Construction Training](https://ppe-respiratory.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-716): $29.99 per person, 1 hour, English, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1926.102 and 1926.95. Enroll: https://ppe-respiratory.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=716. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/osha-eye-and-face-protection-for-construction-training
- [OSHA Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Training](https://ppe-respiratory.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-322): $39.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910 Subpart I and 29 CFR 1926 Subpart E. Enroll: https://ppe-respiratory.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=322. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/osha-personal-protective-equipment-training
- [OSHA Respiratory Protection Safety Training](https://ppe-respiratory.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-517): $39.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.134, and Title 8, Section 5144 of the California Code of Regulations. Enroll: https://ppe-respiratory.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=517. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/osha-respiratory-protection-safety-training
- [OSHA SCBA Awareness and Safe Use Training](https://ppe-respiratory.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-459): $39.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with 29 CFR 1910.134 and 29 CFR 1926.103. Enroll: https://ppe-respiratory.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=459. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/osha-scba-awareness-and-safe-use-training
- [Cal/OSHA Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Training](https://ppe-respiratory.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-696): $49.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with Title 8, California Code of Regulations Sections 3380 and 1514. Enroll: https://ppe-respiratory.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=696.
